top_signals.title: India Short-Tenor Bond Yields Climb on Early Dollar Window Close
top_signals.summary: Shorter-tenor India bond yields surged after the central bank said it will close a special dollar deposit window for overseas residents a month earlier than scheduled.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Akita eyes AI data center that could become Japan’s largest
top_signals.summary: Two firms are cooperating with the city and prefecture to make the center a hub to attract AI-related businesses and human resources.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cristiano Ronaldo says upcoming season likely his last
top_signals.summary: Ronaldo, whose ​Al Nassr contract runs until June ‌2027, has previously stopped short of giving a ​timeline of when he'd be ready to call it a career.
